releases.body:
One MCP server and one skill. Before this release the 18 skill descriptions (about 1.6k tokens) and two servers' tool lists loaded into every session. Now a session loads one short skill description and one tool list.

### Changed

- **One MCP server, `dodopayments`**, at `https://mcp.dodopayments.com/mcp` (Streamable HTTP). It replaces `dodopayments-api` (same URL) and `dodo-knowledge`. Tools: `search_docs` (guide search), `read_docs_page` (a docs page as markdown), `search` (SDK and API method search), `execute` (runs TypeScript SDK code against the signed-in account, in a sandbox) and `feedback` (sends a note to Dodo, with emails, IDs and keys removed first). Server change: [dodopayments/dodopayments-typescript#418](https://github.com/dodopayments/dodopayments-typescript/pull/418) and [#419](https://github.com/dodopayments/dodopayments-typescript/pull/419).
- **One skill, `dodo-payments`**: a `SKILL.md` index of about 130 lines plus 17 reference files loaded on demand (checkout, mobile-checkout, subscriptions, webhooks, usage-billing, credits, license-keys, products, discounts, localized-pricing, customers, refunds-disputes, framework-adapters, better-auth, billing-sdk, testing-go-live, mcp). Source: `dodo-payments/dodo-payments` in [dodopayments/skills](https://github.com/dodopayments/skills), merged in [#42](https://github.com/dodopayments/skills/pull/42) and [#44](https://github.com/dodopayments/skills/pull/44).
- **Sign-in starts when the server is added or connected.** The server returns 401 until the client signs in: `/mcp` in Claude Code, `codex mcp login dodopayments`, `opencode mcp auth dodopayments`, `muse mcp login dodopayments`, `devin mcp login dodopayments`, or `/mcp` in Antigravity and Junie.
- Clients that cannot sign in (grok.com custom connectors, the xAI Responses API, similar connectors) can use `https://mcp.dodopayments.com/mcp?auth=optional`. Then `search_docs`, `read_docs_page`, `search` and `feedback` work without an account and `execute` returns 401.
- `DODO_DISABLE_API_MCP=1` skips registering `dodopayments` in the OpenCode plugin.

### Removed

- The plugin no longer registers `dodopayments-api` or `dodo-knowledge`. `knowledge.dodopayments.com/mcp` still exists as a docs-only server with no account, but is not part of the plugin.
- The 18 skills: `dodo-best-practices`, `dodo-mcp-usage`, `framework-adapters`, `testing-and-go-live`, `checkout-integration`, `subscription-integration`, `mobile-checkout`, `webhook-integration`, `credit-based-billing`, `usage-based-billing`, `license-keys`, `product-catalog-management`, `discounts-and-promotions`, `localized-pricing`, `customer-management`, `refunds-and-disputes`, `billing-sdk`, `better-auth-integration`.
- `DODO_DISABLE_KNOWLEDGE_MCP` is still accepted and does nothing.

### Migration

- The rename from `dodopayments-api` to `dodopayments` makes some clients ask you to sign in again. Use the commands above. Revoke old access in the dashboard under **Settings > Connected Apps**.
- If you added `dodo-knowledge` by hand, remove it, or you get duplicate docs results.
- If you disabled `dodopayments-api` in your own config, rename that key to `dodopayments`.

The API MCP server now signs in through the Dodo Payments authorization server at `auth.dodopayments.com`. The endpoint (`https://mcp.dodopayments.com/mcp`) and every client MCP config stay the same.

### Changed

- **Sign-in is a Dodo Payments consent page.** The first `dodopayments-api` tool call opens it: pick the business, mode and permissions. No step asks for an API key. Review or revoke access in the dashboard under **Settings > Connected Apps**. The README (new [Sign-in and access](./README.md#sign-in-and-access) section), the OpenCode README and the `dodo-mcp-usage` skill describe the flow.
- **Dodo CLI sign-in.** The README, `testing-and-go-live` and the webhook local-testing reference use `npm i -g dodopayments-cli@3.7.0`, then `dodo login` (browser) or `dodo login --device` (SSH), `dodo whoami` and `dodo logout all`. They no longer tell you to paste an API key into `dodo login`.
- `dodo-mcp-usage` names the API server tools (`search_docs`, `execute`), adds Cursor, Codex `config.toml` and OpenCode setup lines, ties the mode and least-privilege rules to the consent page, and explains permission errors.
- OpenAI `publication.release_notes` in `plugin.json` describe the new sign-in.

### Removed

- **Local stdio API server setups** (`npx dodopayments-mcp` with `DODO_PAYMENTS_API_KEY`) from the README, the OpenCode README and `dodo-mcp-usage`. Every documented config uses the remote OAuth server.
- **Claude Code `userConfig`** (`dodo_api_key`, `dodo_webhook_key`, `dodo_environment`). Only the removed stdio setup read these values, so **Configure options** in Claude Code no longer asks for an API key.

The skill edits are made in the vendored `skills/` copy and upstream in [dodopayments/skills#39](https://github.com/dodopayments/skills/pull/39), so that the weekly sync keeps them.

### Fixed

- Removed `extensions["com.openai"].review.test_cases`. The OpenAI portal rejects plugin-level test cases when a plugin bundles more than one MCP server ("Plugin-level test_cases require exactly one MCP server"), and this plugin ships two. The review test cases are entered in the portal instead. The demo recording, commerce declaration and release notes are unchanged.
- OpenAI `brandColor` is now `#6E8E0C`, a darker lime with 3.8:1 contrast against white; the portal requires at least 2:1 and rejected `#C6FE1E`. The brand lime moves to `brandColorDark`.

### Added

- **ChatGPT and Codex plugin directory metadata** in `plugin.json` under `extensions["com.openai"]`, which the OpenAI submission portal imports from the uploaded ZIP: website, support, privacy policy and terms URLs, capabilities, brand color, the five positive and three negative review test cases, the reviewer demo recording, and release notes.
- PNG icon (`assets/icon.png`, 512px) and logo (`assets/logo.png`, 1024px), rendered from `assets/icon.svg`. The OpenAI portal does not accept the SVG as an app icon.

### Changed

- OpenAI `shortDescription` shortened to "Payments and billing for apps"; the portal limits the subtitle to 30 characters.
- OpenAI `longDescription` reworded to describe what the skills and the MCP server actually do. The portal flagged the old wording for promising more than the plugin supports.

### Fixed

- `refunds-and-disputes` no longer links `../webhook-integration/`, which breaks when the skill is installed on its own; it names the skill instead ([dodopayments/skills#31](https://github.com/dodopayments/skills/pull/31)). Clears the last github/awesome-copilot intake lint failure.
